issues.finding: Counting sequents between endpoints is ambiguous and can disagree with the recursive definition, which assigns zero to an axiom and adds one per inference edge.
issues.proposed_resolution: Describe the maximum number of inference steps on a path from end-sequent to initial sequent, exactly matching the recursive definition.

issues.finding: The claimed equal sequents permute the antecedent but also change the succedent from E to D.
issues.proposed_resolution: Keep succedent E in both sequents while swapping only D and E in the antecedent.
